output.headline: The $50 request is above the usual per-head rate for 12 RSVPs, though turnout may be higher at this recruiting GM, so a smaller amount fits precedent better.

reasons.text: At [[S-per-head]] a head, this is above the [[S-target-per-head]] target and the [[S-recent-avg-per-head]] average of the last [[S-recent-count]] similar approvals (e.g. P-14, P-19).

Priya says many more people plan to just show up than RSVP'd, so turnout could be higher than the RSVP count. But the org orders against RSVPs and covers walk-ins with leftovers (see P-09), and the message is context, not approval.

The board notes say recruiting GMs are decided case by case by Jordan, and the only precedent for going a bit over is the kickoff GM (P-01). Treat this as a judgment call for Jordan, not a standing exception.
It leaves [[S-above-reserve-after]] above the [[S-reserve]] reserve with [[S-events-left]] GMs still to go, so the budget is fine, but a lower amount protects the reserve.
